items.item: The form is split into titled sections (personal, job and contract, bank and tax, emergency contact, documents) in a single column, with a visible label above every field and no placeholder-only labels
items.evidence: Five titled sections (h2 '1. Thông tin cá nhân' ... '5. Giấy tờ') with labels above fields and no placeholders. But each section body is 'grid sm:grid-cols-6' with fields at col-span-2/3, so 2-3 fields sit per row (screenshot: Ngày sinh / Giới tính / Tình trạng hôn nhân on one row), not a single column. Emergency-contact labels also lack a 'for' association.

items.item: Required fields are marked consistently, and optional fields are labelled as optional or left unmarked by a stated convention
items.evidence: Required use '.req::after' red asterisk consistently, but there is no legend stating '* = bắt buộc' and optional form fields (e.g. 'Tên gọi khác', 'Chi nhánh') are unmarked with no stated convention. Only the document list says '(không bắt buộc)'.

items.item: Field widths match their content: dates, postal codes and tax codes are narrow; inputs use the right types (email, tel, date)
items.evidence: type=date for dob/cccdDate/startDate/endDate, type=tel for phone, type=email for email, type=number for dependents; dates, CCCD, MST, BHXH are 'sm:col-span-2' (one third of the row) with maxlength and font-mono. No postal code field. Only moderately narrow, not strictly content-sized.

items.item: An option to save the form as a draft is offered, and saving a draft does not demand every required field
items.evidence: #btnDraft 'Lưu nháp' handler writes all field values to localStorage with no validation and shows 'Đã lưu nháp...'; #draftState shows status.

items.item: Save and Cancel stay reachable while scrolling (a sticky bar or equivalent), Save is a verb label and is not disabled before submitting
items.evidence: Action bar 'fixed bottom-0 inset-x-0' with 'Hủy', 'Lưu nháp' and 'Hoàn tất tiếp nhận' (verb phrase); #btnSubmit has no disabled attribute. Visible in first.png.

items.item: Fields validate on blur and on submit; with several errors a summary at the top links to each field and focus moves to the first invalid field
items.evidence: focusout adds field to 'touched' and update() toggles '.err' with inline '.emsg'; submit marks all touched and calls bad.focus() on the first '.err'. But there is no error summary with links to fields; only a generic toast 'Vui lòng sửa các trường được đánh dấu đỏ.'

items.item: Leaving the page with unsaved input triggers a warning
items.evidence: No 'beforeunload' listener anywhere in the script. Only Cancel uses confirm().

items.item: The document upload states accepted file types and the size limit, lists chosen files with a remove button, and is keyboard operable
items.evidence: Section 5 states 'PDF, JPG hoặc PNG, tối đa 5 MB mỗi tệp.', lists files with name/size and a 'Gỡ' remove button. But the file input is 'class="hidden fileIn"' (display:none) inside a label, so it cannot receive keyboard focus; the 'Tải lên' label is not focusable, so upload is not keyboard operable.

items.item: Success is confirmed with a message that names the employee and is announced to assistive technology
items.evidence: Submit toast: 'Đã tiếp nhận '+fullName+' (NV-2026-0148)...' names the employee, but #toast has no role=status/alert or aria-live, so it is not announced.

notes: Fairly conventional, restrained admin layout; no gradients, glass, emoji, KPI tiles or hover-lift. Dark slate-900 sidebar with a blue brand accent is the only template tell. Audit score 80: text-contrast x12 (e.g. 4.34:1 on slate-500 text, 2.98:1 on section dots) and sameAddr target 149x16px. Page loads Tailwind from CDN. Submit success only toasts, no persistent confirmation. Prefilled mock data is shown on load.
